newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Oporto derivatives trade extended Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Oporto derivatives trade extended Wednesday.

text.p: Portugal's Oporto Derivatives Exchange said it would extend trading by an extra 30 minutes until 1600 GMT on Wednesday in line with Lisbon bourse.

Lisbon share trade began some five hours late at around 1330 GMT because of technical problems and the bourse announced earlier that it would prolong its session until 1600 GMT to help make up for the late start.
